objective: Implement deterministic fail-closed duplicate and idempotency prechecks after P16-A using explicit governed replay retention, detecting exact key replays, key collisions and duplicate intent fingerprints without execution authority.
scope: Require successful or vetoed P16-A lineage explicitly
Require non-empty idempotency key and SHA-256 intent fingerprint
Evaluate prior admissions inside an explicit governed replay lookback
Veto idempotency-key collision when the same key maps to another intent fingerprint
Veto duplicate intent fingerprint even when a different idempotency key is used
Fail closed on future-dated prior admissions
Make prior-admission ordering irrelevant to decision identity
Emit deterministic PRETRADE_B_ELIGIBLE or VETO decisions
out_of_scope: Durable storage or distributed lock implementation
tests: Same key with different fingerprint vetoes as collision
Same intent fingerprint under another key vetoes
Prior records outside the explicit replay window do not veto
Decision identity is independent of prior-record ordering
No G8 or execution authority is emitted
P16-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P16-B module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P16-A remains canonical complete and P16-C remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: No production replay default or execution authority
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
